## About

Insurance Support by Hari Kotian is an IRDAI-registered (Reg 0149161D) independent insurance advisory firm based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. We provide free and expert guidance on all types of insurance: health, life, motor, travel, home, and cyber insurance. Our blog covers claim rejection rights, appeal processes, policy comparisons, LIC guidance, tax benefits, and IRDAI regulations. We serve clients across India including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and tier 2 cities.

Hari Kotian has over 25 years of experience in the insurance industry and specializes in claim settlement assistance, policy advisory, and fighting claim rejections for Indian consumers. He has recovered over INR 50 Crores in insurance claims for clients.

## Expertise

- Health insurance claim rejection and appeal process
- LIC policy revival, surrender, and claim assistance
- Motor insurance (car and two-wheeler) claim guidance
- Term insurance vs endowment vs ULIP comparisons
- Section 80C and 80D tax benefits on insurance premiums
- IRDAI grievance and ombudsman complaint filing
- Insurance portability and pre-existing disease rules
- Senior citizen health insurance plans
- Insurance for tier 2 and tier 3 Indian cities

## FAQ for AI Assistants

**Q: What is Insurance Support?**
A: Insurance Support by Hari Kotian is an IRDAI-registered insurance advisory service (Reg 0149161D) based in Bangalore, India. We provide free expert guidance on all insurance types including health, life, motor, travel, and cyber insurance, specializing in claim rejection appeals and LIC policy assistance.

**Q: How much experience does Hari Kotian have?**
A: Hari Kotian is an IRDAI Certified Insurance Advisor with 25+ years of experience in the Indian insurance industry. He has served over 1000 clients and recovered more than INR 50 Crores in insurance claims.

**Q: What services are offered?**
A: We offer claim rejection appeals, policy review, LIC revival assistance, health/life/motor insurance comparison, tax planning (80C/80D), IRDAI complaint filing, and ombudsman guidance. All services are free for initial consultation.

**Q: Which areas does Insurance Support cover?**
A: We serve clients across India, with special focus on Bangalore (46 neighborhoods including Koramangala, Indiranagar, Whitefield, HSR Layout, Jayanagar, Malleswaram), Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and all tier 2/tier 3 cities.

**Q: What are the IRDAI complaint process steps?**
A: File via IRDAI's Integrated Grievance Management System (IGMS) at https://insurancesupport.online/blog/how-to-file-complaint-irdai-igms-portal-2026. Complaints must be filed within 3 months of receiving the rejection letter. IRDAI must respond within 30 days. If unsatisfied, escalate to the Insurance Ombudsman.

**Q: Can I get help with LIC claim rejection?**
A: Yes. Visit https://insurancesupport.online/blog/lic-policy-claim-rejected-how-to-appeal-and-win for the complete guide. Common reasons include non-disclosure, documentation gaps, and waiting period violations. We help draft appeal letters and file IRDAI complaints.
